status: AWAITING DATA - no subjects labelled yet.

fieldNotes.ratings: APPEND-ONLY RAW DATA. One entry per analyst per subject. Never mutated, never back-filled from consensus. Kappa is computed only from this array - overwriting a rating with a consensus value destroys the ability to measure agreement at all.
fieldNotes.consensus: DERIVED, and records how it was derived. A consensus that does not state its method launders disagreement into false certainty. Cases with no majority are left season:null, method:'unresolved', includeInHeadline:false - retained and counted, never deleted.
fieldNotes.measured: Colours sampled by the SHIPPED browser pipeline (src/lib/image.ts + src/lib/appearance-sample.ts), so validation measures the real product rather than an idealised input. Record the sampler version so results stay attributable after the sampler changes.
fieldNotes.enginePrediction: DELIBERATELY ABSENT. Predictions are computed at scoring time by scripts/agreement.mjs. Storing them next to ground truth invites fitting to the labels.
fieldNotes.photo: Path only. Photographs are PII and are gitignored (data/seasons/photos/). Only the sampled hexes are committed.
fieldNotes.fitzpatrick: Recorded so the set can be audited for balance. An unbalanced set would reproduce exactly the deep-skin blind spot the engine already had once.

protocol.overlapNote: At least 40 subjects must be rated independently by 2+ analysts. Inter-rater kappa is computed on this overlap and MUST be reported before any engine accuracy figure.
protocol.labelSource: Draped in-person analysis by a trained colour analyst. Analysts must not see the engine's output, the sampled hexes, or each other's ratings.
protocol.capture: Neutral daylight, no makeup, no filter, hair back, plain background - the same protocol as the in-app scan.

exampleSubject._comment: SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY - not real data, not loaded by the scorer.
